# krateo-nutanix-operator-kog — LLM doc index
# One line per file. This repo ships a chart family: the nutanix-v4-proxy chart
# (helm/nutanix-v4-proxy), the nutanix-virtualmachine blueprint and the nutanix-chain-lookup
# demo (helm/*), plus 189 generated KOG RestDefinitions (generated/). The two release
# artifacts version independently — the proxy on a v-prefixed tag, the blueprint on a plain tag.
docs/index.md: the map — the chart family, what each piece is, and the repo layout
docs/overview.md: the generation pipeline (RestDefinition -> KOG -> CRD + controller), why a proxy, what the blueprints add, coverage + limits
docs/usage.md: prerequisites, install the v4 proxy, apply the RestDefinitions, deploy the VM blueprint standalone or as a composition, the chain-lookup demo
docs/configuration.md: values of nutanix-v4-proxy, nutanix-virtualmachine and nutanix-chain-lookup, the proxy env, RestDefinition mapping conventions
docs/api.md: the KOG-generated resource + <Kind>Configuration CRDs, the Vm resource, and the nutanix-virtualmachine CompositionDefinition
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples
docs/release.md: how the proxy image+chart (v-tag) and the blueprint chart (plain tag) ship, and how the CompositionDefinition tracks the published version
docs/log.md: curated history
examples/nutanix-virtualmachine/README.md: provision a full Nutanix AHV VM as a single KOG Vm, standalone or as a NutanixVirtualmachine composition
examples/nutanix-virtualmachine/composition.yaml: the NutanixVirtualmachine composition manifest (composition.krateo.io/v0-3-0)
# Source (read these for ground truth):
helm/nutanix-v4-proxy/values.yaml: proxy values, config.pcBase required
helm/nutanix-v4-proxy/Chart.yaml: the proxy chart metadata (chart + appVersion = proxy script version)
helm/nutanix-virtualmachine/values.yaml: the VM blueprint values with rationale
helm/nutanix-virtualmachine/values.schema.json: the typed schema core-provider derives the composition CRD from
helm/nutanix-virtualmachine/compositiondefinition.yaml: the blueprint's Krateo registration (spec.chart.version = published chart)
helm/nutanix-chain-lookup/README.md: the day-2 lookup-coupling demo and its caveats
generated/README.md: how each of the 189 RestDefinitions is produced (trim + sanitize + verb mapping)
generated/ANALYSIS.md: the per-resource inventory (verbs, sync/async, slice size) across 19 namespaces
